DOP: titthiya titthya m. [ cf BHS tīrthika, tīrthya], an adherent of another sect; a non-Buddhist ascetic ; Vin I 54, 19 (vibbhamanti pi ~esu pi saṅkamanti); III 245, 19 (kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā hatthesu piṇḍāya carissanti seyyathā pi ~ā ti; Sp 1025, 20 : yathā ājīvikanāmakā ~ā); IV 225, 28 (~e upasaṅkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci); Sn 381 (ye kec’ ime ~ā vādasīlā ājīvikā vā yadi vā nigaṇṭhā); 891 (evaṃ hi titthyā puthuso vadanti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee tithyā; Nidd I 300, 8 : titthyā vuccanti diṭṭhigatikā, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce titthiyā) quoted Sadd 625, 14 (titthyā); Ja I 37, 18 (Padumuttarassa pana bhagavato kāle ~ā nāhesuṃ sabbe devamanussā buddham eva saraṇaṃ agamaṃsu); III 74, 19 (~ā … kaṇṭakāpassaye seyyaṃ kappenti pañcatapaṃ tapanti nānappakāraṃ micchātapaṃ caranti); 126, 6 (~ā hi anuppanne buddhe lābhino ahesuṃ uppanne pana hatalābhasakkārā suriyuggamane khajjopanakā viya jātā); Nidd I 473, 11 (saṃsaṭṭho viharati rājūhi rājamahāmattehi ~ehi °-sāvakehi ananulomikena gihisaṃsaggena; Nidd-a I 451, 29 : ~ā ti viparītadassanā bāhiraparibbājakā, °-sāvakā ti bhattivasena tesaṃ paccayadāyakā); Paṭis I 160, 4 (~o ca °-sāvako ca yo ca micchādiṭṭhiko ime tayo puggalā vipannadiṭṭhī); Ap 28, 19 (tasanti ~ā sabbe nadato te mahāmuni); Mil 99, 21 (~ā sake vāde naṭṭhā honti); Vism 507, 9 (suvānavuttino pana ~ā); Ps II 7, 23 (titthaṃ nāma dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyo … tāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ uppādetā titthakaro nāma tassa laddhiṃ gahetvā pabbajitā ~ā nāma); Spk III 171, 16 (~ānaṃ hi samaye pañcanīvaraṇappahānaṃ vā mettādibrahmavihārabhāvanā vā n’ atthi); Mhv 5:74 (~ānaṃ sahassāni nikkaḍḍhitvāna saṭṭhi so); — titthiyasmiṃ yeva in Ee at Sv 1039, 23 is prob. wr; Be, Ce, Se titthiyasamaye; — ifc see añña ( sv añña 2 ), kutitthiya; — °- (d)dhaja , m.n. , the emblem or characteristic sign of one belonging to another sect ; Vin I 306, 6 (na bhikkhave ajinakkhipaṃ ~aṃ dhāretabbaṃ); II 22, 27 (na gihidhajo dhāretabbo na ~o dhāretabbo; Sp 1159, 9 foll. : kusacīrādīni na dhāretabbāni); — °- pakkantaka , mfn. [ perhaps for titthiya + *apakkantaka? cf BHS tīrthikāvakrāntaka], who has gone over to another sect, an apostate ; Vin I 86, 33 (~o bhikkhave anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo upasampanno nāsetabbo ti; Sp 1021, 2 : titthiyesu pakkanto paviṭṭho ti ~o); 136, 1 (na ~assa … pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ); Sp 515, 17 (theyya-saṃvāsako ~o bhikkhuṇīdūsako ti imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saggo avārito maggo pana vārito va); 990, 24 (so ~-ttā na upasampādetabbo); 1021, 1 foll. ; Kkh 2 30, 11 ; — atitthiya , m. , one who is not an adherent of another sect ; Vin IV 92, 21 ; — see also nānātitthiyagatika ( sv nānā ).
